messages:
maria: heads-up, starting a tiny refresh of the HelloBox quickstart. noticed a few drift bits after the SDK v5 release — auth env var, client init, and the example that assumes synchronous responses.
ash: can you list the exact mismatches? i'll take the JS snippets.
maria: sure: 1) bash snippet exports REDWOOD_API_KEY but SDK v5 expects REDWOOD_KEY. 2) example does `const client = new Redwood()` which isn't exported; should be `const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })`. 3) curl example uses /v1/generate but we standardized on /api/v1 for hosted docs.
viv: Also noticed the docker-compose example pins python:3.8 which broke in recent test runners. we should move to python:3.11-slim.
noah: i can swap the compose + Dockerfile base, and add a short note about multi-arch builds (`--platform=linux/amd64`) for arm CI.
liz: product asked that the quickstart show streaming vs non-streaming generation side-by-side. small inline snippet ok?
maria: yes, add a tiny streaming example in Node (EventSource / fetch with ReadableStream). keep it brief.
nash: i'll update the code snippets and add a migration note: "If you're upgrading from SDK v4, rename REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY and replace legacy client init." also will add a short test matrix (node 18+, python 3.11).
viv: FYI some links on the page point to the old embeddings guide; i'll update them to the new embeddings index.
ci-bot: Reminder: quickstart docs touching Dockerfiles must include 'tested-on-arm' CI label per repo policy.
docs-bot: PR checklist: include 'compatibility note', 'changelog entry', 'smoke test steps'.
maria: proposed plan: noah updates Dockerfiles + compose in PR A, ash updates snippets + migration note in PR B, liz updates links and streaming example in PR C. i'll coordinate merges so staging gets coherent content.
noah: PR A: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1550 
- bumps python image to 3.11-slim
ash: PR B: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1551 
- updates node + bash auth snippets, client init, add migration blurb
liz: PR C: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1552 
- streaming vs non-streaming snippets, link fixes to embeddings index
maria: can each PR include a small 'how i tested' note in the description? would make reviews faster.
noah: added: "locally built on mac-arm, ran docker-compose up, executed sample request" in PR A.
nash: added: "ran Node sample with Node 18 and verified env var flow" in PR B.
liz: added: "manual preview + link linter" in PR C.
ci-bot: CI: PR 1550 (checks passing), PR 1551 (one snippet test failing: missing env var in test harness), PR 1552 (link linter warning).
maria: ok, ash can you patch the test harness so the snippet test injects REDWOOD_KEY?
nash: on it. will push tiny fix to 1551.
ash: pushed fix, CI now passing.
docs-bot: Approval request: maria, viv, noah.
maria: reviewing PRs now. quick note: adjust the 'first deployment' section to show both Hosted (curl) and Private (docker-compose) flows; product prefers this parallel view.
liz: added the parallel panel in 1552. kept both examples under 8 lines each.
maria: approved all three. merging sequence: 1550, 1551, 1552.
ci-bot: Merged 1550. Staging deploy queued.
ci-bot: Merged 1551. Staging redeploy queued.
ci-bot: Merged 1552. Staging deploy: docs-staging -> prod scheduled if smoke checks pass.
noah: ran end-to-end smoke test on M1 workstation: docker-compose build + up, sample request succeeded with python 3.11 and --platform flag. added steps to PR A.
maria: great. final todo: add small callout about credential rotation (link to key management runbook) and add a line reminding readers to pin the SDK version during upgrade. anyone pick that?
liz: i'll add both in a tiny follow-up doc commit after prod deploy.
maria: timeline: aim to have everything live by tomorrow morning PST. thanks team :)
